balanced_binary_tree.dispersion_meaning: estimator dispersion: every seed measures the same graph, so the spread is walk and estimator noise only
balanced_binary_tree.why: a deterministic tree with a fixed branching ratio: exponential ball growth, no dimension of any kind, and the case where d_s's false-confidence is easiest to see against a known answer

erdos_renyi_degree_16.dispersion_meaning: ensemble dispersion: each seed measures a different graph draw, so the spread is graph-to-graph variation plus estimator noise
erdos_renyi_degree_16.why: a random graph at mean degree 16, the middle of the cap of 32: no finite dimension, to be refused (the operator, 2026-11-18 19:18)

erdos_renyi_degree_2.dispersion_meaning: ensemble dispersion: each seed measures a different graph draw, so the spread is graph-to-graph variation plus estimator noise
erdos_renyi_degree_2.why: the structureless case at the mean degree the gate's laws live at: nominal <d> 2, a giant component of 80% at <d> 2.40. A ring and a random tree are anchored at 2; this is the random graph beside them. d_s reads 1.47 to 1.52 from 1,024 up, on the branching line (1.40) to +0.1, and no other channel answers

erdos_renyi_degree_32.dispersion_meaning: ensemble dispersion: each seed measures a different graph draw, so the spread is graph-to-graph variation plus estimator noise
erdos_renyi_degree_32.why: a random graph at mean degree 32, the top of study 169's cap: no finite dimension, to be refused (the operator, 2026-11-18 19:18)

erdos_renyi_degree_6.dispersion_meaning: ensemble dispersion: each seed measures a different graph draw, so the spread is graph-to-graph variation plus estimator noise
erdos_renyi_degree_6.why: past the top of the band: nominal <d> 6, where 520 found the withheld d_s values flatten at 5 to 7. The spectral probe refuses here on every seed; what fools the instrument instead is d_V, near 5 up to 8,192, before its window is long enough to see the exponential (under analysis-3.0.0; 4.0 refuses it at every rung, 627)

erdos_renyi_dense.dispersion_meaning: ensemble dispersion: each seed measures a different graph draw, so the spread is graph-to-graph variation plus estimator noise
erdos_renyi_dense.why: the top of the band, and the dangerous case. d_s does NOT stop answering here: it refuses intermittently in the middle of the ladder and answers on all ten seeds at 262,144, reading 2.821 to 2.827. What it does stop doing is tracking <d> - 1: the giant component sits near 4.08, the branching line predicts 3.08, and the probe reads 2.824, a residual of -0.26 that puts it OUTSIDE the branching-line gate. A law reproducing this scores a full 25 for stability and is not withheld; only the refusal of the other three channels distinguishes it from a geometry

erdos_renyi_mid.dispersion_meaning: ensemble dispersion: each seed measures a different graph draw, so the spread is graph-to-graph variation plus estimator noise
erdos_renyi_mid.why: the centre of the band campaign 8 drew from. Measured giant-component <d> 3.18 and d_s 2.18: on the branching line to -0.000. Any law whose residual profile matches this family is reproducing an Erdos-Renyi graph and nothing else

erdos_renyi_sparse.dispersion_meaning: ensemble dispersion: each seed measures a different graph draw, so the spread is graph-to-graph variation plus estimator noise
erdos_renyi_sparse.why: the survey's null ensemble at the low end of its mean-degree window. Locally tree-like, log diameter, a positive density of cycles, no dimension. Measured giant-component <d> 2.77 and d_s 1.80: on the branching line to +0.03

hyperbolic_geometric_graph.dispersion_meaning: ensemble dispersion: each seed measures a different graph draw, so the spread is graph-to-graph variation plus estimator noise

structure.gap_reason: no solve converged (lanczos_deflated: ArpackNoConvergence); too well connected to factorise

hyperbolic_geometric_graph.why: points of a hyperbolic disc joined within a fixed distance, mean degree 12: a drawn hyperbolic space, which under 4,096 nodes no measure of its balls parts from a geometry

hyperbolic_triangle_tiling.dispersion_meaning: estimator dispersion: every seed measures the same graph, so the spread is walk and estimator noise only
hyperbolic_triangle_tiling.why: seven triangles at a node, grown outward by layers: a negatively curved surface, local structure everywhere and balls that grow exponentially, so no probe may read a dimension

periodic_a4_lattice.dispersion_meaning: estimator dispersion: every seed measures the same graph, so the spread is walk and estimator noise only
periodic_a4_lattice.why: the close-packed 4D lattice of 20 neighbours (A4) on a torus: 4D at a degree inside the cap of 32 (the operator, 2026-11-18 19:18)

periodic_body_centred_cubic_lattice.why: the body-centred cubic start, eight neighbours: three dimensions on another lattice

periodic_cubic_lattice.dispersion_meaning: estimator dispersion: every seed measures the same graph, so the spread is walk and estimator noise only
periodic_cubic_lattice.why: 3D torus; the campaign's plausible upper dimensional range

periodic_cubic_quotient.dispersion_meaning: estimator dispersion: every seed measures the same graph, so the spread is walk and estimator noise only
periodic_cubic_quotient.why: the cubic start as the fleet builds it at every size a law runs, a torus folded where the size is no cube

random_3_regular.dispersion_meaning: ensemble dispersion: each seed measures a different graph draw, so the spread is graph-to-graph variation plus estimator noise

random_4_regular.dispersion_meaning: ensemble dispersion: each seed measures a different graph draw, so the spread is graph-to-graph variation plus estimator noise

sierpinski_gasket.dispersion_meaning: estimator dispersion: every seed measures the same graph, so the spread is walk and estimator noise only
sierpinski_gasket.why: exact fractal: all three channels differ; the finite-size bias of d_B on this family is the study's known hard case

uniform_random_tree.dispersion_meaning: ensemble dispersion: each seed measures a different graph draw, so the spread is graph-to-graph variation plus estimator noise
uniform_random_tree.why: a real tree with three exact and distinct dimensions (Brownian CRT: d_f=2, d_w=3, d_s=4/3). Every tree has <d> -> 2, so the branching line predicts d_s = 1 and the truth is 4/3: this family is the known object that shows the line does not describe trees

periodic_face_centred_cubic_lattice.why: the face-centred cubic start, twelve neighbours and triangles: the densest of the three

periodic_honeycomb_lattice.why: 2D torus with degree 3: the sparsest planar lattice

periodic_hypercubic_lattice_4d.why: 4D torus: beyond the campaign's plausible range, the integer ceiling of the probes

periodic_ring.why: the 1D torus bounds the probes from below; ordinary diffusion

periodic_square_lattice.why: 2D torus; arrives converged with no boundary

periodic_tesseract_quotient.why: the 4D start as the fleet builds it at every size a law runs

periodic_triangular_lattice.why: 2D torus with degree 6: does a 2D reading depend on the lattice or the dimension?

random_3_regular.why: the object the branching line actually describes: a locally tree-like regular expander whose local limit is the Bethe lattice. <d>-1 = 2 exactly and d_s reads 2.08, so a law on the line looks like this, not like a tree. random_4_regular sits one degree higher, where d_s stops answering at all; the two together bracket the band the survey searches in

random_4_regular.why: expander: exponential ball growth, no finite dimension of any kind; every confident probe reading here is a defect

sierpinski_carpet.why: second exact fractal (d_f = log8/log3); d_s and d_w have no closed form here and are charted unjudged

sierpinski_gasket.why: exact fractal: all three channels differ; the finite-size bias of d_B on this family is the study's known hard case

uniform_random_tree.why: a real tree with three exact and distinct dimensions (Brownian CRT: d_f=2, d_w=3, d_s=4/3). Every tree has <d> -> 2, so the branching line predicts d_s = 1 and the truth is 4/3: this family is the known object that shows the line does not describe trees
